snapshot.text: Universal health insurance run through the Social Security Institution, with a large public hospital network and a growing health tourism sector. Current focus is on shorter waits for imaging, prevention (smoking, obesity) and early cancer diagnosis.

priorities.title: Shorter waits for MRI and CT
priorities.text: The ministry has expanded MRI capacity and sped up MRI and CT appointments.

priorities.title: Lower smoking and obesity
priorities.text: A plan to cut smoking and obesity rates, with new tobacco rules on the way.

priorities.title: Health tourism
priorities.text: More than 3 million people have come to Türkiye for treatment; the minister wants to grow health tourism further.
